get.description: Resolves caller identity via Supabase JWT, triggers JIT provisioning on first call, and returns profile + participant state.
Returns caller profile if they hold ADMIN role in the profiles table, otherwise returns 403 Forbidden.
Returns a paginated list of non-draft campaigns. Supports optional status filtering.
Returns public details for an open or completed campaign. Draft campaigns return 404.
Returns current participant registration state, admission availability, and campaign lifecycle state from server truth.
Returns personal draw result: WON (with rank and entitlement), WAITLISTED, or NOT_REGISTERED.

post.summary: Join campaign waiting room and obtain cryptographic admission permit
post.description: Validates campaign state and issues a short-lived, HMAC-SHA256 signed admission permit token.

post.summary: Register participant entry for campaign with idempotency
post.description: Atomically consumes the admission permit, evaluates risk/challenge seams, and creates a unique registration entry.
Creates a new campaign in DRAFT state. Seats are not generated until prepare step.

get.description: Returns all campaigns including DRAFT and PREPARING, with aggregated seat and registration metrics.

schema.title: Response List Campaigns Admin Api V1 Admin Campaigns Get

get.description: Returns full administrative view of campaign with inventory counts and pauses.

patch.description: Updates policy and metadata fields while campaign is in DRAFT or PREPARING state.

post.summary: Prepare campaign and generate seat inventory
post.description: Transitions DRAFT -> PREPARING, calculates policy hash, and bulk-inserts initial seat inventory.
Transitions PREPARING -> OPEN. Makes campaign visible to the public and open for registrations.
Transitions OPEN -> CLOSED. Halts all new registrations.
Transitions CLOSED -> FROZEN, captures policy snapshot, and locks eligible participant roster.
Executes verifiable lottery draw, creates LotteryEntries and Entitlements, and transitions FROZEN -> CLAIMING.
Pauses ADMISSION, REGISTRATION, or REDEMPTION without altering lifecycle state.
